name: Crema
summary: Coffee bar sign-in: milk pours into your cup as you type, a lid hides your password, latte art at the end
about: A full sign-in page for a Karachi coffee bar, with the form printed on a kraft loyalty card above a counter with an espresso machine, a cake stand and swinging pendant lamps. Typing your email lifts the milk jug and fills the cup while the pressure gauge jumps; the password puts a take-away lid on the cup, and a wrong one wobbles the cup and flashes TRY AGAIN on the machine. Signing in pours a latte-art heart, writes your name on the cup and stamps your card.
how: Watch the page pour a demo login by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email: the jug pours, the cup fills and the gauge needle jumps with each key
Click the password: a lid goes on the cup; the eye button tips it open for a peek
Try a wrong password, or use Fill it in (sana@crema.pk, flatwhite7) for latte art and a new stamp
On Join the club your name is written on the cup and each password rule earns a stamp; the reset code is 418207
